# PRTV — digital signage editor (prtv.pro)

> PRTV is a cloud editor for digital signage: menu boards, promo screens and info channels shown on Smart TVs, set-top boxes and browsers. Slideshows are built from slides and elements in a fixed 1920×1080 space; live widgets (clocks, weather, rates, QR, countdowns, calendars, feeds) are added from public builders on s.prtv.su. Aimed at cafés, restaurants, salons and small businesses in Russia/CIS, with English materials for international users.

## Skills for AI agents (Agent Skills format, CC-BY-4.0)

Open instructions that let an AI agent work in the prtv.pro editor through its interface. Load prtv-editor-overview first.

- [prtv-editor-overview (EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prtvbiz-design/prtv-skills/main/prtv-editor-overview/SKILL.md): map of the editor — objects, coordinate space, panels, DOM conventions, fonts, TV slots

- [prtv-text-element (EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prtvbiz-design/prtv-skills/main/prtv-text-element/SKILL.md): native text, toolbar, what persists, menu-row traps
- [prtv-text-element (RU)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prtvbiz-design/prtv-skills/main/prtv-text-element/SKILL.ru.md): элемент «Текст»
- [prtv-html-block-animation (EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prtvbiz-design/prtv-skills/main/prtv-html-block-animation/SKILL.md): HTML block, CSS/SVG animation without JavaScript, recipes
- [prtv-html-block-animation (RU)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prtvbiz-design/prtv-skills/main/prtv-html-block-animation/SKILL.ru.md): HTML-блок и анимация
- [prtv-video (EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prtvbiz-design/prtv-skills/main/prtv-video/SKILL.md): video element, background video, seamless loops, sound on TVs

## Product

- [Editor](https://prtv.pro): account, slideshow list, editor at /slideshow/<id>, public player at /<TV-number>
- [Widget builders](https://s.prtv.su/informery): 30 public builders — clocks, weather, calendars, QR, countdown, rates, promo cards, maps and more
